description: A headache is a pain in any region of the head. It can occur on one or both sides of the head.
general_guidance: Rest in a quiet, dark room
seek_medical_help: If it is severe, sudden, or accompanied by fever, stiff neck, or confusion.
emergency_warning_signs: Headache with fever and stiff neck
disclaimer: This is general educational information. Not a medical diagnosis.

description: Brain fog isn't a medical condition itself, but a symptom of other conditions. It involves memory problems, lack of mental clarity, and inability to focus.
general_guidance: Ensure you get 7-8 hours of sleep
seek_medical_help: If symptoms persist for a long time and affect daily life.
emergency_warning_signs: Memory loss following a head injury
disclaimer: This is general educational information. Not a medical diagnosis.

description: An infection caused by the varicella-zoster virus. It causes an itchy rash with small, fluid-filled blisters.
general_guidance: Take cool baths with baking soda or oatmeal
prevention: Vaccination is the most effective way to prevent chickenpox.
seek_medical_help: If the rash spreads to the eyes, or if it becomes very red, warm, or tender (indicating a secondary infection).
disclaimer: This is general educational information. Not a medical diagnosis.

description: A viral infection that attacks your respiratory system — your nose, throat and lungs.
seek_medical_help: If you are at high risk of complications or if symptoms are severe and not improving.
disclaimer: This is general educational information. Not a medical diagnosis.

description: Conditions that affect sleep quality, timing, or duration and impact a person's ability to properly function while they are awake.
common_symptoms: Waking up often during the night
general_guidance: Avoid caffeine late in the day
seek_medical_help: If sleep problems last more than a few weeks or affect your daily life.
emergency_warning_signs: Pauses in breathing during sleep (sleep apnea)
Falling asleep at dangerous times (like driving)
disclaimer: This is general educational information. Not a medical diagnosis.

description: A healthy lifestyle includes balanced nutrition, regular physical activity, adequate rest, and good mental health practices.
general_guidance: Eat a variety of foods including plenty of fruits and vegetables
Exercise regularly (aim for 150 minutes a week)
seek_medical_help: Consult a doctor before starting any rigorous new exercise or diet program, especially if you have existing health conditions.
disclaimer: This is general educational information. Not a medical diagnosis.

description: Dehydration occurs when you use or lose more fluid than you take in, and your body doesn't have enough water and other fluids to carry out its normal functions.
prevention: Hydrate extra during exercise or hot weather
seek_medical_help: If you have had diarrhea for 24 hours, are irritable or disoriented, can't keep fluids down, or have bloody or black stool.
disclaimer: This is general educational information. Not a medical diagnosis.
